fields.description: Issue includes political commentary on Florida state government and proposed taxation, including discussion of Governor Sholtz, Representative Dan Chappell, and comparisons to Huey Long. It features extensive advocacy for the Florida Recovery Act aimed at curbing chain stores and supporting local merchants. Local civic and political coverage includes the Miami municipal election and candidate listings, along with proposals for a Pan-American Exposition using the former Royal Palm Hotel site and Bayfront Park. Regular columns and sections cover sports (including baseball and racing), entertainment and nightlife listings, and consumer/advertising content; a public-safety editorial warns about Miami High School students hitchhiking and suggests school buses.
